"From Sagarmatha to the sea, the climate crisis connects us all." 🏔️🌊    At a recent gathering of Pacific leaders, Nepal’s delegate highlighted the shared, existential threat of global warming. The message is clear: what begins as melting ice in the high Himalayas inevitably cascades into rising tides in the Pacific Ocean.   Despite contributing minimally to global emissions—with 100% of its electricity coming from hydropower and 46% of its land covered by forests—Nepal is paying the ultimate price. Just weeks ago, a terrifying "Himalayan tsunami" triggered by a high-altitude glacial collapse swept through the Bhotekoshi River valley, claiming over 1,400 lives, leaving thousands missing, and wiping out vital infrastructure.    As nations prepare for COP31 in Antalya, Nepal is calling for a formal "Sagarmatha to the Sea" partnership to unite mountain and ocean communities. The demand is simple but urgent: the world must deliver predictable climate finance, fully capitalized loss and damage funds, and uncompromised climate justice.    The crisis is already here; our response must be equally urgent, united, and ambitious. 🌍🤝   #ClimateAction #ClimateJustice #COP31 #Himalayas #PacificIslands

🚨Shocking visuals coming from Nepal's Gorkha District today. A massive, black debris-filled flood surged down the Budhi Gandaki River early this morning after a landslide blocked the river in Chumnubri village. The temporary dam suddenly burst, unleashing a wall of water, mud and rocks. In the video you can see entire buildings with green roofs being swallowed in seconds as people watch helplessly from the hilltop. According to authorities, more than 35-65 houses in Salleri Bazaar, Jagat, Paiyuka and riverbed settlements have been swept away. At least 4 bridges including 2 motorable bridges were destroyed. 5 to 10 people are reported missing so far, and 49 people have been rescued and airlifted by the Nepal Army. A RED ALERT has been issued for downstream districts - Gorkha, Tanahun, Chitwan, Nawalparasi. Residents are being urged to stay away from the river and move to high ground. This comes just 2 months after the deadly August flood in Nepal that killed over 1,400 people. Pray for Nepal. 🙏 #NepalFlood #PrayForNepal #Gorkha #FlashFlood #NepalNews
